cr_data.provenance: (The Downtown Gallery, New York, NY); Private collection, New York, NY, 1958; ACA Galleries, New York, NY, before 1969; Harry Spiro, New York, NY, 1969; M. Knoedler, New York, NY, 1975; Barbara Babcock Millhouse, New York, NY, 1975 (Source: Lynes, 1999)
remarks_1999: Whitney Archive indicates, "Exam. At Amer. Place, March 1946. . . . No signature [notes backing inscription 1] Written by O'Keeffe. 'Walk in Lake George/Pond in Centre' [not verified] . . . . Note: O'Keeffe dates this 1922. See gallery photograph 2–f." Abiquiú Notebooks indicates, "Sold by Halpert, April 1958." Pictured in 1923 New York (Anderson) Stieglitz installation photograph, see Appendix III, figure 13. Titled *Walk in Lake George – Pond* in *Center* by Stieglitz on Abiquiú Notebooks photograph. (Source: Lynes, 1999)

credit_line: Gift of Barbara B. Millhouse in memory of  E. Carter, Nancy Susan Reynolds, and Winifred Babcock
description: In this semiabstract landscape, a still pond reflects blue mountains with a bright green and brown strip of land below. The land opens up, forming a circular, cave-like shape at the center of the composition. A narrow strip of bright blue sky is just barely visible above the mountains.
